correctness.rationale: Literal mathematical statements replay. (a) Universal rung: for N=F7 (3-connected, |E|=7, not wheel/whirl) Seymour's splitter gives for any 3-connected M with proper F7 minor an e with M\e or si(M/e) 3-connected F7-retaining; binarity and M(K5)-freeness are minor-hereditary so preserved; |E| strictly drops (|E|=7 with F7 minor forces =F7) so iteration terminates at {F7}; binary excludes U(2,4) hence U(2,5). Step 2 wheel/whirl discussion is redundant (N not wheel/whirl so exception vacuous) but conclusion true; wheels regular/F7 non-regular and whirls non-binary facts correct as cited. (b) Four witness towers: stdlib verifier replays (ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py -> MINIMALITY_OK [(1001,10),(1002,11),(1003,10),(1001,11)], VERIFY_OK 4 witnesses sizes [11,12]); rank by GF(2) basis insertion, 3-connectivity by exhaustive partition lambda table (all X ni 0, lambda=r(X)+r(Y)-r(E), flags k=1,2; correct after halving fix), F7 models by C (|C|=r-3 independent) + S (|S|=7) + full perm isomorphism to standard 28-base F7 (not just count), contraction/deletion reversal checked per step, simplicity checked. M(K5)-freeness of tops/chain holds by counting lemma n-(r-4)<10 (tops: 8,8,8,9 <10; intermediates same), not by the logged 0-model exhaustive search which is vacuous as honestly noted. Per-element census replayed. One deletion spot-check (W0 e=0) confirmed F7-absence by full minor search beyond the need-sized search. Proof (a, counting) vs computation (b, lambda/F7 replay) distinguished; limitations (no C census, Seymour/wheel facts cited) honestly stated.

originality.rationale: Nearest prior Seymour splitter theorem (1980, doi:10.1112/jlms/s2-22-2-236) substantively covers headline (a). Instantiating N=F7 (non-wheel/whirl) immediately yields every 3-connected M with F7 minor reduces by one 3-connected F7-retaining step; adding binary and M(K5)-free heredity and |E|-termination adds no new content -- textbook minor-closed heredity and size induction. Hence O=empty at rank 7 has been known since 1980, not a new obstruction list. Strong Splitter (arXiv:1201.4427), Kingan EX[E4] (arXiv:1408.2377), Kingan-Lemos prism-free (arXiv:1203.3741) indeed list no rank-7 F7-rooted M(K5)-free matrix, but absence there does not make a Seymour corollary new; general existence does mechanically imply the M(K5)-free reduction because M(K5)-freeness is minor-closed. Part (b) four towers (seeds 1001,1002,1003 + one extension, n=11,11,11,12, bases 201,208,201,386) are new strings but arbitrary random coextensions by construction (search.py random.Random(seed), 500 tries), explicitly NOT splitter-minimal (10-11 good moves each; report admits fallback M0 not found). They are illustrations of the guaranteed abundant reductions, not canonical extremals, seeds, or blockers. A failed arXiv search or timestamp does not establish priority.

value.rationale: Headline (a) is textbook restatement / parameter substitution (Seymour with N=F7 plus hereditary flags) with no reusable new lemma: since O=empty there is no terminal case to cite, and witnesses all reduce so provide no decomposition blocker. Headline (b) is unexplained enumeration of arbitrary objects: random tower matrices and their computed invariants (base counts, 10/11 good-move counts, lambda tables) had no pre-computation identity, motivation, or downstream use; certification alone does not rescue an arbitrary object. This is not the eligible narrow-invariant case (natural motivated object + unknown non-implied exact value future work needs). Full C census honestly disclaimed, but the remaining universal existence + 4 building-block chains is exactly the mechanically implied fragment plus illustrations, with no new extremal, obstruction, criterion, or cited reduction lemma.
